scope: Fresh Ubuntu 26 traces: 50 normal + 50 selected-valid rootkit batches, 100 listing runs per batch.
primary_rule: Archived training models and thresholds frozen before these fresh traces; alarm if score < threshold.
legacy_rule: Threshold selected to maximize F1 using these same fresh test labels; reported only as optimistic reproduction.
positive_retry_policy: One 99-PID ls_basic acquisition was preserved but replaced by a separately preserved 100-PID retry; ls_basic remains descriptive and outside the frozen four-scenario model.
